invariants.rationale: The method returns a List<String> collected from a stream, which never produces null.
FileSlice#getFileId should not return null, and only such values are collected.
The result is collected after applying .distinct(), so all entries are unique.
If no file slices, result is empty; if any slices exist, result will have at least one fileId.
The method signature preconditions likely require a non-null partitionPath, else NPE in getLatestFileSlices.
